```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "M2 carries about 39 uA instead of I1 because the mirror is sized through two independent LUT sizings, so the ratio is off. This pulls the output low, drives M1 into triode, and collapses gain and GBW. I use one unit PMOS W with an explicit width ratio K=I1/IREF for the mirror, so M2 mirrors I1 exactly."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.5, 12, 16),         # NMOS CS gm/Id; sets gm1 for GBW and gain
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),       # NMOS CS length
    "gmid2": (9.5, 8, 12),           # PMOS load/reference gm/Id
    "L2":    (0.3, 0.25, 0.3),       # PMOS load/reference length (same L on M2 and M3)
    "IREF":  (5e-6, 4e-6, 6e-6),     # PMOS reference current (M3 diode)
    "K2":    (11.0, 10.0, 12.0),     # mirror ratio M2:M3 (rounded to integer); I1 = K2*IREF
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)   # testbench reference current drives ibias
    IREF = p["IREF"]
    K = int(round(p["K2"]))
    I1 = K * IREF                    # exact mirror: M2 = K x M3 in width, same L

    # Signal NMOS CS, sized for its own branch current I1
    op1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.9)

    # PMOS unit device sized at IREF; M3 = 1x, M2 = Kx (explicit width, same L)
    opr = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], IREF, vds=0.9)
    W_unit = opr.W
    L2 = p["L2"]

    # NMOS mirror: diode M0 at testbench iref, M4 sinks IREF (same gm/Id and L)
    op0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    op4 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, IREF, vds=0.6)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", op1)                 # signal NMOS CS
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_unit * K, L2)  # PMOS load, K x unit
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", opr)                    # PMOS diode, 1x unit
    n.dev("M4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", op4)                 # NMOS sink: IREF
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", op0)              # NMOS diode at ibias

    # Analytic predictions
    gm1, gds1 = op1.gm, op1.gds
    gds2 = K * opr.gds               # gds scales with width at same gm/Id and L
    gain = gm1 / (gds1 + gds2)
    f3db = (gds1 + gds2) / (2 * PI * cl)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cl)
    power = VDD * (I1 + iref + IREF)
    swing = (VDD - opr.vdsat) - op1.vdsat

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain),
        "f3dB": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": 0.9,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
